index.value: Morningstar Wide Moat Focus NR AUD Index
index.note: VanEck writes it 'Morningstar® Wide Moat Focus NR AUD Index™'. At least 40 attractively priced US companies Morningstar rates as having a wide economic moat; two staggered sub-portfolios, equal-weighted at each reconstitution. US-only; not currency hedged (MHOT is the hedged version).

mer.note: Management fee 0.49%; indirect costs 0.00%; transaction costs 0.01% p.a. (FY to 30 Jun 2026)

yield.note: VanEck's 12-month fund dividend yield as at 30 Sep 2026 (prior 12 months' dividends / closing NAV at period end), driven by one large $11.61 payout in Jul 2026. Its 12-month income return is 9.47%. The underlying shares' own dividend yield is only 1.70% (fact sheet), so most of the payout is not from company dividends and the figure swings a lot year to year.

franking.note: VanEck shows the franking level as '--'; US shares carry no franking credits

listed.note: First day of trading on the ASX (ASX company listing date). Daily prices start here.

inception.note: Fund inception (seeded before quotation); listed on the ASX the same day, 26 Jun 2015

distributions.note: VanEck: '1 each year'. Since 2023 the period ends 30 June (ex-date about 1 July); up to 2021 it was paid around December/January
